frustrated.title: Frustrated
frustrated.plain: Something is wrong, blocked, or not going their way.

selftalk.title: Self-talk
selftalk.plain: Content and vocalizing to themselves. No response needed.

social.title: Social
social.plain: They want to connect or get your attention.

dysregulated.title: Dysregulated
dysregulated.plain: Overwhelmed. Lower the noise and give space.

more.title: More
more.plain: Wants more of what just happened.

protest.title: Protest
protest.plain: Objecting. They do not want this.

results.summaryNote: The striped bar is the same MFCC model scored the common way, with clips from one session on both sides of the split. It looks 1.6 times better than it is. Every other bar keeps sessions apart.

attempts.idea: DistilHuBERT fine-tuned end to end (finetune.py; run stopped at epoch 8 of 12, epoch 7 chosen on calib)
